text_block_list.text:
One morning, during the New Year's
holiday,
Gold City and I come to the
shrine thinking it
would be a nice change
of scenery. However...
Actually, I should go back.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You don't want to make a wish?

text_block_list.text: Nope. No wishes here.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wishes won't do a thing for what I lack
in skill.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Also, quit trying to do so much for me.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's not like stuff like this helps me feel
better.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You're worried I'll be trash in the Osaka
Hai,
right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You should just pull me out. If we quit
now,
then—
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You're not pulling out of the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.text: Then... I don't get it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Let's try something other than running today.

text_block_list.text:
I figure forgetting about the race for a
moment
might help flip her mood.
However...
Something other than running...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...I can't think of anything.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I just realized I don't have any particular
hobbies.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити falls silent. I should offer an
idea
instead...
choice_data_list: Why don't we go lie down at the park?
You want to play some video games?

Want to know what it's like to be on the other
side of the lens?

text_block_list.text: Ew, what?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Sure then, I guess... It's not like there's
anything
else I want to do.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how nice it feels
under the sun.
Coming out here to lie
down might not be so bad
an idea, after
all...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
After saying this, Голд Сити carefully sits
herself
down. And then, in the blink of
an eye...
Zzz... zzz...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...I had a dream.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I was running in an empty meadow.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I gotta... get back to it.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Like?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Music games, racing games, fighting
games...
They've got everything.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's all a different world to me, but it
might be
nice to try out a new hobby.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hmm... Oh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
How about a dance game? I can use my
whole
body, so maybe it'll help with my
running.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Like, it could be a pretty good workout
if you do
it seriously. You might even
gain some muscle.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Uh-oh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Well, it's still technically not running, so...

text_block_list.text:
Actually, let's try the racing game! Here,
let's go
against each other.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
You mean, like, me taking photos of
you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: What?! No, like... scenery and stuff.

text_block_list.text:
Right. Yeah, of course. Still, me as a

photographer, huh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Well, shall we go for a walk and try it
out then?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити and I decide to take a walk,
with
phones in hand.
No, you're gonna catch me! Hahaha!
text_block_list.name: Children

text_block_list.text: Looks like it. Seems fun.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Do you want to join them?

text_block_list.text: What?! No way.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're so pretty!
text_block_list.name: Children

text_block_list.text: Huh?! When did you all get here?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You want to play with us? That's okay!
text_block_list.name: Child A

text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's your turn to run from all of us! You
better
hurry! We're coming!
text_block_list.name: Child B

text_block_list.text:
All of you?! That's not how tag is
played—wait! I
didn't agree to this!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, she's so fast! Come on,
everyone! Catch
her!
text_block_list.name: Children

text_block_list.text: Can you stop chasing me?! Noooo!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Click!

Голд Сити closes her eyes and sleeps for
a bit
longer.

We enjoy a few games together, steering
clear
from the dance ones.
I manage to get a nice photo at the end.
Well, thanks for walking me back.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Were you able to clear your head?

text_block_list.text:
A little. It's not like it'll change anything,

though...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Still...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
If nothing will change, then I might as
well run in
the Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: You seem so eager to make me enter.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
And I don't want to make a fool of
myself, since
everyone will be watching.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: So...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Sure, but could you quit it with the extra

enthusiasm already?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Anyway, today was...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Never mind.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
